def transform(grid):
    """Summarize each cell compartment by whether it contains an accent."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_cuts = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_cuts[i] + 1, row_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_cuts) - 1) if row_cuts[i + 1] > row_cuts[i] + 1]
    col_spans = [(col_cuts[i] + 1, col_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_cuts) - 1) if col_cuts[i + 1] > col_cuts[i] + 1]
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_spans:
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
            accents = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row.append(1 if accents >= 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
